description: Flagged for review: irregularities and gaps found while building line-desk. None blocks publication; every value that cannot be confirmed from an official source is blank on the published pages. Each row carries its source.

rows.issue: No official public price source exists: the NFL's official sports-betting data feed is distributed by an exclusive distributor to operators and media, not published free.
rows.handling: Market line and difference columns are blank on every row; nothing is filled from third-party records.

rows.issue: Price-snapshot store has 0 market captures: 45 market records exist (15 games x side/total/moneyline) but market_open and market_close are blank on all of them, and our close capture does not run yet (45 open, 0 close).
rows.handling: Coverage published on the price-snapshots page; store stays incomplete rather than back-filled.

rows.issue: Verified results feed covers weeks 7, 8, 9 and the week-10 Thursday game only (44 games). Weeks 1-6 (93 games per the committed snapshot) are pending official capture.
rows.handling: Pending rows listed with blank scores and the official URL where each capture must come from.

rows.issue: The committed nflverse snapshot (as-of 2026-11-01) carries blank scores for games that are now final (week-8 Monday, all of week 9, week-10 Thursday) - it is stale for current results.
rows.handling: Official feed values override; cross-check recorded per row (27 compared, 27 match, 0 mismatch, 17 games blank/absent in snapshot).

rows.issue: No official depth source: the NFL.com team depth-chart path returns HTTP 404 and the official injury report has no depth-rank column (both verified first-hand 2026-11-14).
rows.handling: Every replacement and string-tier cell is blank on every depth row; the deficiency signal stays uncomputed.

rows.issue: Injury sample covers 4 clubs first-hand (WAS, NYG, NE, DET - page chunk 1 of 8); the remaining clubs on the Week 10 report were not transcribed by this session.
rows.handling: Coverage stated on the depth page; no claim of full-report coverage.

rows.issue: Two committed pipelines publish different 'our' lines for the same 15 games: data/derived/model.json vs results/originate.json differ by 1.5 to 9.0 points on every slate game (largest: NYG at PHI 3.4 vs -5.6, gap 9.0).
rows.handling: line-desk publishes data/derived/model.json only (the root lines page source); the full discrepancy table is on the origination page; canonical-originator decision requested (SG-05/Q-03).

rows.issue: Strategy ROI, p-values and correlations outside this desk's official set are computed from the third-party nflverse extract with undocumented price provenance; sibling audit found missing prices historically imputed in one pipeline (issue #19, since fixed there).
rows.handling: Every such number on this desk's pages is labelled third-party/computed and linked to its repo file; official-only pages carry no such values.

rows.issue: Reward tiers are published while the pool is unfunded (0 points payable) and jurisdiction terms are undecided.
rows.handling: Reward column states 'design, not funded'; Q-07/SG-08 open.

rows.issue: No strategy passes promotion: 0 of 7 candidates clear 10/10 gates (max 5/10), so the demotion gate has no live subject and no reward can be earned.
rows.handling: Published on leaderboard and gates pages as the honest state of the competition.

rows.issue: Demotion thresholds (n >= 200, one-sided 95%) are project proposals, not an official standard, and have not been validated on live results.
rows.handling: Labelled PROPOSED in gates.json and on the gates page; Q-06 opens the power analysis.

rows.issue: The repository tracks a Python virtual environment (.venv-b6: 6,214 files) and open PR #97 touches those paths; it bloats clones and diffs.
rows.handling: Flagged only; removal proposed as SG-12 and coordinated with PR #97's owner - not edited here.

rows.issue: line-desk has no root-navigation link yet (root nav files are owned by other sessions with open PRs #93/#97).
rows.handling: Link request logged in COORDINATION.md; the site is live at its own path regardless.

rows.issue: Official correlation window is two seasons (2025-2026) because standings are hand-transcribed; intervals are wider than a longer window would give.
rows.handling: n and CI published with every coefficient; extension proposed as SG-07.

rows.issue: Signal-rank tie-break (raw p asc, then decided n desc) is needed because all seven candidates share the same BH-adjusted p (0.984847); the rule is proposed, not standard.
rows.handling: Published next to the ranking rule; reviewer acceptance requested (Q-14).

rows.issue: Root README quotes model MAE 10.38 vs market 9.70 while committed data reads 10.391 vs 9.711 (carried from sibling review IR-02); not this desk's file, not edited here.
rows.handling: Recorded for the root owner; no line-desk page repeats the rounded figures as exact.
